text:
elaine: Quick follow-up after the midnight outage where KV evictions triggered fallback storms. Goal: agree owners, deliverables, and concrete test additions (regression pack, targeted prompts, perf profile, chaos drill).

mira: Summary: eviction + route flapping -> sustained increased latency and several failed requests. Postmortem draft lists fixes but no explicit tests. We need reproducible suites so we don't regress.

toni: I'll build a small regression harness that simulates route flapping + cache cold start. Plan: parameterize cache hit ratio, router availability, and model size. CI job name suggestion: `ci/regress/kv-routing`. ETA 6d.

ash: I'll curate the prompt set that exposed hallucinations during timeouts. Will extract ~60 real prompts from logs, label expected snippets, and add to evals. Storing under `redwood/evals/incident_packs/2026-03-kv-evict.csv`. ETA 10d.

ryan: From perf: I'll add a KV-miss-heavy load scenario to our k6 suite and record p50/p95/p99 baselines. Also include a short burst pattern (12k->3k over 8m). ETA 7d.

samir: I'll own the chaos drill design and runbook: steps to safely kill router/kv host, expected alarms, rollback play. Recommend tabletop first, then live drill next month. ETA doc in 4d.

elaine: Let's make acceptance criteria concrete so QA/Oncall can sign off:
- Prompt regression: 99% pass on labeled checks (no missing expected tokens).
- Perf: p95 token latency < 220ms on baseline infra for the KV-miss profile.
- Regression harness: deterministic reproduction of the sequence (cache cold, route flaps) in CI.
- Chaos drill: drill runbook + retro within 48h of exercise.

mira: Also add alert sanity: ensure we have metrics for prefix eviction rate and a synthetic heartbeat to detect router flaps within 30s.

toni: I'll add smoke assertions to the harness to fail fast in CI if route fallback occurs. Will open GH issue `redwood/regress#998` and link PR.

ash: Example prompt CSV line I'll include:
`inc_id,input,expected_keywords`
`2026-03-23-01,"List the main changes to the privacy policy","privacy,effective"`
I'll attach metadata with the source log id.

ryan: k6 snippet (sketch) for KV-miss profile:
```js
// VUs simulate clients that mostly miss cache
export default function () {
  http.post('/v1/generate', payload, { headers });
  sleep(0.02);
}
```
I'll add graphs to perf PR and post results.

samir: Proposed cadence: regression pack runs nightly; targeted perf runs weekly; chaos drill quarterly with tabletop monthly.

devops-bot: Reminder created for tabletop drill 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. Invitees: @eng-ml, @eng-sre.

elaine: Solid. Please paste issue/PR links back here when ready. I'll update the incident board with owners and ETA. Plan to reconvene next Thursday for status.

mira: Thanks all, adding acceptance criteria to the postmortem now.

toni: Opening issue + initial PR shortly.

ash: Will upload prompt pack and create `ci/evals/prompt-regression` job.

ryan: Perf PR by EoD next Tuesday.

elaine: Great, closing thread. Will ping for the follow-up sync. :white_check_mark:
